messages.subject: Re: [Tinn-R] Tinn-R window-tab bug when trying to open a file that is locked by some external software
messages.subject_clean: [Tinn-R] Tinn-R window-tab bug when trying to open a file that is locked by some external software
messages.body_plain:
Hi Marc,
I also noticed what you reported. And I've also noticed similar behavior when wanting to delete folders that have (or had) files that were opened by Tinn-R, when a file opened in Tinn-R is deleted by another application.

I'll take a look (via debug to see if I can identify where the source code can be improved) to give users more freedom and flexibility.

Best,

------ Mensagem original ------
De: "marQIsoft" <marc.lau...@gmail.com>
Para: "Tinn-R Editor - GUI for R Language and Environment" <tin...@googlegroups.com>
Enviado(s): 30/09/2021 10:07:48
Assunto: [Tinn-R] Tinn-R window-tab bug when trying to open a file that is locked by some external software

> Hi again, Jose,
>
> A small bug I got, not for the first time. When trying to open a file that is already opened (and protected: locked) by a software such as Excel, Tinn-R is not able to open the file and fails to create a new window in the editor. But it still creates a window tab. Which is impossible to get rid of aftewards. Here is what happens after I have closed all valid child windows in the editor. An error msg when trying to "close" the empty tab.
>
> Not a very important issue, but if you have an idea how to solve it easily.
>
> Thanks again
>
> Marc
>
>
